title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Penei Sewell has contract restructured by Lions
items.desc: The Lions restructured the contract of LT Penei Sewell.
items.impact: WR Amon-Ra St. Brown also had his contract restructured. The Lions created $35.68 million in cap space.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown has contract restructured by Lions
items.desc: The Lions restructured the contract of WR Amon-Ra St. Brown.
items.impact: LT Penei Sewell also had his contract restructured. The Lions created $35.68 million in cap space.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Erick Hallett II elevated for Week 1
items.desc: The Titans elevated S Erick Hallett II for Week 1 against the Jets.
items.impact: Hallett will add depth in the secondary for Tennessee on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mohamoud Diabate elevated for Week 1
items.desc: The Titans elevated LB Mohamoud Diabate for Week 1 against the Jets.
items.impact: Diabate will add depth at linebacker for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kaden Davis elevated by Bears for Week 1
items.desc: The Bears elevated WR Kaden Davis for Week 1 against the Panthers.
items.impact: It is unclear if this relates to the status of Rome Odunze, who is listed as questionable. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status Sunday morning.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Rush suffers back spasms, still expected to start Sunday
items.desc: Falcons QB Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday but is still expected to start in Week 1 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Rush is getting the start with both Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. unavailable. Rush remains expected to play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Stroud, Texans pause extension talks
items.desc: The Texans and QB C.J. Stroud will pause contract discussion until after the 2026 season.
items.impact: The two sides tried to come to an agreement on a deal before the season. Stroud will play out the final year of his rookie deal, minus the fifth-year option.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Malik Davis (hip) placed on season-ending injured reserve
items.desc: Malik Davis (hip) has been placed on season-ending IR after undergoing surgery on his hip.
items.impact: It's a tough blow to the veteran running back, who worked his way up the depth chart past two much younger and potentially more intriguing prospects. He will now focus on returning in 2027, but his road will be much harder, as he will be nearly 29 when next season rolls around.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Eli Stowers (quad) placed on IR
items.desc: Eli Stowers (quad) has been placed on IR due to a quad injury.
items.impact: Stowers was already struggling throughout training camp, and this quad injury won't help matters. It's likely 2026 is going to be a redshirt year for him, focusing primarily on development for 2027.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Greg Dortch elevated from practice squad
items.desc: Greg Dortch has been elevated to the Bills' active roster ahead of their game against the Texans.
items.impact: Dortch will be a depth option, but he will likely see little work, as he is buried on the depth chart. He's been productive when given the opportunity in the past, but it will be hard to find that in Buffalo.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Frank Gore Jr. elevated from practice squad
items.desc: Frank Gore Jr. has been elevated from the Bills' practice squad ahead of their game against the Texans.
items.impact: Gore will provide depth and likely see some snaps on special teams, but is unlikely to see any real action on offense given the running backs ahead of him on the depth chart.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Israel Abanikanda signed to active roster
items.desc: Israel Abanikanda has been signed to the active roster by the Dallas Cowboys the organization announced.
items.impact: Abanikanda will be in the backfield mix for head coach Kurt Schottenheimer after Malik Davis was placed on injured reserve Saturday, with Javonte Williams remaining a dynamic RB1 option that will see as much volume as he can handle against the New York Giants Sunday night.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Michael Mayer agrees to a three-year, $45 million deal with Raiders
items.desc: Michael Mayer has agreed to a three-year, $45 million deal with the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Mayer is an all around contributor, making it well worth the investment for the Raiders. For fantasy, it means that he is behind Brock Bowers for the long term, but maybe the Raiders will employ more tight end sets so both can eat, as they are likely the two most talented pass catchers on the team at this point in time. Time will tell what his fantasy value will become.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tucker Kraft signs four year, $75 million deal with Packers
items.desc: Tucker Kraft has agreed to a four-year, $75 million deal with the Green Bay Packers. The deal is worth up to $92 million.
items.impact: Kraft was on his way to a massive season in 2025 before going down with a torn ACL. He gets his payday as the Packers lock in their emergeing star for the long haul.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Sweat (knee) off injury report Week 1
items.desc: Josh Sweat is off the injury report and will play in Week 1 against the Chargers.
items.impact: Sweat practiced fully on Friday. He appears to be fully healthy heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Atonio Mafi claimed off waivers by Titans
items.desc: The Titans claimed OG Atonio Mafi off waivers.
items.impact: Mafi was previously waived by the Raiders. He will add depth on the offensive line for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Levi Onwuzurike released by Lions
items.desc: The Lions released DL Levi Onwuzurike.
items.impact: Onwuzurike tore his ACL last offseason. He'll seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to have big role if available in Week 1
items.desc: Saints RB Alvin Kamara will not have a "huge role" if he plays in Week 1 against the Lions.
items.impact: Kamara was listed as questionable after he practiced fully on Friday. He'll be eased into the season if he is available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Rodgers Sr. has contract restructured by Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings restructured CB Isaiah Rodgers' contract.
items.impact: The move opens up cap space for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Braxton Berrios to be elevated Sunday
items.desc: The Giants' plan to elevate WR Braxton Berrios from the practice squad on Sunday.
items.impact: It is believed to be unrelated to the status of Malik Nabers.

items.impact: Pran-Granger was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.impact: Stewart was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. (illness) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Richardson will backup Daniel Jones to open the season.

items.impact: Ogletree was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: AJ Haulcy is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Haulcy was a full participant in practice. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charvarius Ward off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Charvarius Ward is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Ward was limited in practice on Friday. He will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Alec Pierce is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Pierce is not expected to face a snap count. He is fresh off his contract extension this offseason.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeForest Buckner off injury report Sunday
items.desc: DeForest Buckner is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Buckner was eased in practice this week, including missing practice on Friday. He'll be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Austin Ajiake (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Austin Ajiake is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Ajiake was a late addition to the injury report on Friday. His status is up in the air on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: The rookie is officially being listed as questionable to play in Sunday's season opener. There have been a lot of optimistic reports surrounding his availability, so it looks more likely than not that he will suit up against the Chargers, although that decision won't be made until closer to game time. If he is ruled out, Tyler Allgeier will be primed for a massive workload in Week 1 in Love's absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Jeanty practiced in full all week. He should be good to go in his lead role to open the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seydou Traore (thumb/Achilles) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Seydou Traore is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Traore was a full participant in practice on Friday. He'll be good to go in his depth role to open the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dante Trader Jr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Dante Trader Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Trader was a full participant in practice on Friday. He'll be good to go in his depth role to open the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Kacmarek (calf) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Will Kacmarek is off the injury report for Sunday's game against Raiders.
items.impact: Kacmarek is good to go as had been reported.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: As expected, Meyers carries no injury designation ahead of Sunday's season opener and will be available to play against the Browns. His presence is further competition for Parker Washington and Brian Thomas Jr. in a crowded Jacksonville WR room.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Allen is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still dealing with a hip injury of some kind, but he was able to take part in multiple practices this week, so he will have a real shot at suiting up against the Browns. Look for Chris Rodriguez Jr. to see more work if Allen is ruled out for the season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devontez Walker (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Devontez Walker is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Walker was limited in practice all week. He'll hold a depth role if he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Madubuike had his career threatened, but he was cleared this offseason to return. He'll figure to still be eased back by Baltimore.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Mitchell has been dealing with a nagging hamstring injury for a while, but it appears he is finally over it, as he has received full clearance to suit up and play for the Chargers in their season opener. He will remain relegated to a depth role behind Omarion Hampton for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Zay Flowers is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Flowers missed some practice time in the past couple of weeks with a hamstring injury. He'll be a full-go heading into the season off a new contract.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Calais Campbell (rest) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Calais Campbell is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Campbell will be a full-go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (hip) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (hip) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Thompson has been cleared to play for Sunday's game, meaning that his hip injury isn't a very serious issue at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Teddye Buchanan has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Buchanan was limited in practice all week. It won't be enough for him to be cleared for the season opener.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play in Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined on Sunday. He's still recovering from an injury to his pec right now, and the team wants to give him all the time that he needs to rest and make a full recovery before playing. His absence will leave Philadelphia's defensive front slightly weaker than usual against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) officially questionable Sunday
items.desc: Malik Nabers is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: The reports all week have suggested Nabers is expected to be good to go for Sunday's season opener. He should be on the favorable side of questionable going into the weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Harrison Jr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Harrison Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Harrison practiced in full on Friday. He is good to go as expected.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Isaiah Davis (knee) cleared to play Week 1
items.desc: Isaiah Davis (knee) has been cleared to play in Week 1's matchup against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Davis will be available to play in Week 1, as his knee injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point. He isn't expected to have much of a role on Sunday, especially with Breece Hall (groin) fully healthy and set to play against the Titans.
